messages:
oncall-bot: PagerDuty alert: multiple upstream 5xx spikes detected from gateway (edge-01..edge-04). Error rate > 12% in last 2 min, increased latency. Paging on-call: @Laura.

Laura: I’m awake, looking. seeing 502/503 from envoy at the gateway. digging into lb configs now.

Matt SRE: I can join in 2m, rerouting traffic might help short-term. Any customer-visible 503s in dashboards?

Laura: Yes - top affected route /api/v1/generate -> 15% 5xx from edge region us-west-2. Some retries causing downstream saturation.

Nisha (infra): Can you paste the envoy stats?

Laura: paste: ```
cluster.upstream_rq_5xx: 1420
cluster.upstream_rq_retry: 980
listener.0.0.0.0_443.downstream_cx_closed: 230
route.ratelimited: 0
```

Kevin (edge): Noticed a recent LB config push at 08:14 that modified retry_policy and circuit_breakers for candidate routes. Possibly the culprit. I’m pulling the diff.

ops-bot: Deploybot: config-change by @kevin at 2026-03-14T08:14:12Z - roll id cfg-20260314-08-14-12

Laura: If retries are aggressive and CBs are tight we could see retry storms and upstream overload -> 5xx. Recommend disabling retries at gateway for affected route.

Matt SRE: Agreed. Can we apply a hotfix: set `retry_policy` to `num_retries: 0` for /api/v1/generate and raise max_connections in CBs to avoid immediate tripping?

Nisha (infra): I can patch the route in the control plane. Will push a config with retries removed and CB thresholds bumped to 200 for that cluster. Rolling to edge-01 first for canary.

Laura: ETA?

Nisha (infra): Patching now. Running `cictl deploy-config --roll cfg-20260314-hotfix-01 --target edge-01`.

ops-bot: Deploybot: started rollout cfg-20260314-hotfix-01 -> edge-01 (user: Nisha)

Laura: Meanwhile enable rate-limit fallback to fail-open for a small % so we don't cascade. Can someone confirm rate-limit config?

Kevin (edge): Rate-limiter already set to fail open by default for this route. Good.

Matt SRE: Monitoring the 5xx count and p50/p95 latency. Setting alert to 5% threshold for immediate notice.

ops-bot: Deploybot: rollout to edge-01 succeeded in 18s.

Nisha (infra): Canaries look good on edge-01, pushing to edge-02..edge-04 with 30s stagger.

Laura: After removing retries, I'm seeing upstream 5xx drop to 4% within ~45s on edge-01. Good sign.

Matt SRE: P95 latency also dropping. Looks like retry amplification was the trigger.

Kevin (edge): Pushing a hot rollback of the cfg-20260314-08-14-12 change where retry_policy was added. We'll keep the new CB thresholds.

ops-bot: Deploybot: rollback initiated for cfg-20260314-08-14-12 -> applying revert to route config.

Laura: Customer impact quick check: ~12% of requests to /api/v1/generate saw errors at peak. Estimated affected requests ~3.1k/min for 7m -> ~21.7k requests. Top customers: internal QA and two enterprise tenants; CS posted in #support with screenshots.

Matt SRE: Notify CS: @support-team please warn impacted customers and state mitigation is underway.

Kevin (edge): Rollback completed. No more retry logic on route; CBs kept relaxed. Watching for regression.

Laura: Current error rate back to 1.2%, latency within normal. Marking as mitigated but monitoring for 30m.

Nisha (infra): I'll open a runbook ticket to add a pre-deploy check to block retry policy changes on high-traffic routes without canary. Also suggest automated smoke after config change.

Matt SRE: +1. Add to postmortem: root cause = config change that enabled aggressive retries + low circuit breaker thresholds -> retry amplification/backpressure causing 5xx.

ops-bot: Incidentbot: customer-impact = partial, severity = Sev2, start=1749000000, mitigated=1749000245

Laura: On-call handoff: I’ll stay for the next 30m then hand to Matt. Matt, please take on-call after 09:00 UTC.

Matt SRE: I’ll take it. Thanks Laura.

Nisha (infra): Creating incident ticket INC-20260314-003 and linking deploy diffs and logs.

Kevin (edge): Follow-up action: revert the config change in git, add CI gate to forbid retry_policy changes on `/api/v1/*` unless opt-in with canary flag.

Laura: Closing thread for now. Keep alerts enabled. If error >5% again, re-open and page. :thumbsup:
